findings.claim: `nx dep-graph` and `nx affected:graph` do not exist — they are absent from the Nx CLI reference, so they no longer run.

source.quote: The command list documents nx graph, nx affected -t <target>, and nx affected --graph.

findings.claim: Nx v23 deprecates executor-based tooling in favour of inferred plugin targets, with removal in v24. This repo declares 54 explicit executor targets by hand across apps/*/project.json and libs/**/project.json, so the v24 migration is not the 22-target scope an earlier count reported.

source.quote: Executor-based tooling is deprecated in favour of inferred plugin targets and will be removed in Nx 24.

incidental.summary: nx.json renames the inferred @nx/eslint/plugin target to "eslint:lint" — a local configuration choice no upstream statement grounds, confirmed with `git log -S'eslint:lint' -- nx.json`, which is not about anything Nx documents.
